Proto.Name: ICMP
Proto.Description: Layer 3 Internet Control Message Protocol (RFC 792) header. 8-byte fixed header (type, code, checksum, and a 4-byte rest-of-header that varies by type) followed by type-specific data. Used for error reporting and diagnostic messages like echo request/reply (ping), destination unreachable, time exceeded, redirect, timestamp, and router discovery.
Fields: id              {16 bits}  = 0 (echo-request/reply, timestamp, info, address-mask, extended-echo)
seq             {16 bits}  = 0 (echo-request/reply, timestamp, info, address-mask, extended-echo)
unused          {32 bits}  = 0 (dest-unreach, source-quench, time-exceeded, and other deprecated types)
gateway         {32 bits}  = 0.0.0.0 (redirect only, IPv4 address of preferred gateway)
pointer         {8 bits}   = 0 (parameter-problem only, indicates octet where error was detected)
num_addrs       {8 bits}   = 0 (router-solicitation/advertisement, number of address entries)
addr_entry_size {8 bits}   = 2 (router-solicitation/advertisement, size of each router address entry in 32-bit words)
orig_ts         {32 bits}  = 0 (timestamp/timestamp-reply, milliseconds since midnight UT of originate time)
recv_ts         {32 bits}  = 0 (timestamp/timestamp-reply, milliseconds since midnight UT of receive time)
trans_ts        {32 bits}  = 0 (timestamp/timestamp-reply, milliseconds since midnight UT of transmit time)
mask            {32 bits}  = 0.0.0.0 (address-mask-request/reply, subnet mask of the requesting host)
